cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Pick the Prize
cards.instruction: Make them choose which reward, principle, or relationship matters most when not everything can be kept.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. You can keep the prize money or fund the team trip. Which matters more?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we do a cheaper trip?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Only if someone adds money. You hold the prize.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking you to choose before everyone else quietly pays for it.

mechanism: A requires its former team-budgeting pupil to choose private prize money or collective travel once the minimum fare leaves no cheaper escape.
confusable: Not simply accusing selfishness: A requires the actual allocation decision before others inherit the cost.
comparison: Personal reward versus team relationship, rather than anniversary timing.
seedUse: D202 prize/trip/cheaper/others pay; S05 minimum-budget arithmetic.
